2026.title: Dungeon Meshi
2026.review:
i watched this subbed as it aired and then rewatched it dubbed this year, but i dont quite remember when. 
really like this anime. feels like a rpg but so silly! i cant wait for a second season. its a perfect mix of action and "slice-of-life" that NEVER gets boring.
the's really not many shows that catch your attention as much as this one. plus, they present the world building without an annoying narrator that explains everything, it's just smoothly baked into the story itself.
i havent watched many animes of this genre but i would bet it's one of the best of its kind. purely because i don't think this genre is that interesting and still fell in love with this one.
